```yaml
management:
  endpoints:
    access:
      default: none
  endpoint:
    loggers:
      access: read-only
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: "*"
        exclude: "env,beans"
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoint:
    env:
      show-values: when-authorized
      roles: "admin"
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      discovery:
        enabled: false
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      cors:
        allowed-origins: "https://example.com"
        allowed-methods: "GET,POST"
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoint:
    health:
      status:
        http-mapping:
          down: 503
          fatal: 503
          out-of-service: 503
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoint:
    health:
      group:
        custom:
          include: "db"
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoint:
    health:
      group:
        custom:
          exclude: "db"
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoint:
    health:
      group:
        custom:
          show-details: "when-authorized"
          roles: "admin"
          status:
            order: "fatal,up"
            http-mapping:
              fatal: 500
              out-of-service: 500
```

```yaml
livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: "/actuator/health/liveness"
    port: <actuator-port>
  failureThreshold: ...
  periodSeconds: ...

readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: "/actuator/health/readiness"
    port: <actuator-port>
  failureThreshold: ...
  periodSeconds: ...
```

```yaml
management:
  endpoint:
    health:
      group:
        readiness:
          include: "readinessState,customCheck"
```

```yaml
info:
  app:
    encoding: "UTF-8"
    java:
      source: "17"
      target: "17"
```
